newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia March housing finance down 1.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia March housing finance down 1.3 pct.

text.p: Finance commitments for owner-occupied housing in Australia fell 1.3 percent by volume to 39,931 dwellings in March from a February level of 39,448, seasonally-adjusted, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
In value terms, housing finance rose to A$4.19 billion in March from A$4.13 billion in February, the bureau said.
Analysts forecasts had centred on a rise of 1.0 percent in volume commitments for March.

The bureau said finance commitments for the construction of dwellings fell 5.9 percent, commitments for the purchase of established dwellings fell 0.4 percent and those for the purchase of new dwellings fell 3.0 percent.
The bureau said the number of commitments under new finance, excluding refinancing, increased slightly in March following a fall of 5.9 percent in February.
